findings.summary: Security bindings and policies authenticate only caller-computed self-digests, not authoritative task or runtime state.
findings.required_fix: Pin bindings and policies to the durable task snapshot and installed security-runtime manifest.

findings.summary: Evidence provenance, classification, redaction, freshness and independent-review trust can be self-attested by the caller.
findings.required_fix: Consume clock, bindings, classification, producer trust and review receipts through attested state.

findings.summary: Disclosure validation does not authorize the concrete destination, authority object or delivery receipt.
findings.required_fix: Bind concrete destination and authority state and accept only action-journal-issued receipts.

findings.summary: Retention can authorize purge from caller assertions instead of durable holds and object metadata.
findings.required_fix: Evaluate and revalidate purge against a repository-issued immutable subject snapshot.

findings.summary: Redaction and path handling do not consistently fail closed under resource exhaustion and symlink races.
findings.required_fix: Bound recursive ingress and bind path use through no-follow descriptors.
